utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll spread the word and rally a few more neighbors for the repair drive. If you know what’s most urgently needed, I can share that too.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, it’s still on for Sunday at the community center, right?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, it’s on Sunday at the community center now — I’ll double-check if you need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes — Saturday morning at the community center on Oak Street first; please spread the word, and I’ll keep an ear out for what’s needed most.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Cleo. Just send me the top priorities when you know them, and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Uli — I’m still taking stock, and I’ll send you the top priorities for the repair drive soon.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me what still needs doing and where the repair drive is headed? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I help out.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey, sorry I’m late — I’m not sure on the remaining details either, but I do know it’s headed to the community center.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: It’s at the community center on Sunday now—tell me what still needs doing and I’ll help out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — Sunday at the community center. I’ll check what still needs doing and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s moved to Sunday at the community center now—what time works best for you?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sunday works for me—midmorning is best. I can bring a few tools and help wherever you need.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still tracking the repair drive location—what spot are we starting with?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It’s on Sunday at the community center now. I can help out there.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still on—just not today. We moved the repair drive to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks—what still needs doing for the repair drive at the community center on Sunday?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Not yet — we’re still putting the repair drive details together. I’ll fill you in as soon as we know more.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Alright, just keep me posted on the Sunday setup at the community center, and I’ll help once we know what’s needed most.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sunday at the community center works for me. Just let me know what time to be there and what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — I’ll send the time and the list of repairs once I’ve finished sorting it out.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks for checking in, Leo — the repair drive is on Sunday at the community center now. I’m still sorting the remaining tasks and will send the list shortly.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Rosa — Sunday at the community center works. Send the task list when you can.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely—I’m in, but I still need the exact issue and where the repair drive is headed. Tell me when and where, and I’ll help out.
